text: The captain who has got an army together, and perceives that from want of money or friends he cannot maintain it long, must be a mere madman if he do not at once, and before his army melts away, try the fortunes of battle; since he is certain to lose by delay, while by fighting he may chance to succeed.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
reference: Discourses on the First Decade of Titus Livius
